card.name: Benjamin Sisko, Besieged
card.text: Play with the top card of your library revealed. You may play lands and cast creature spells from the top of your library.

card.name: Bio-Asset Allocator
card.text: Artifact creatures you control have "Whenever this creature attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."

card.name: Borg Queen, Perfection Manifest
card.text: Artifact creatures you control get +2/+0. When Borg Queen enters, assimilate target creature card from an opponent's graveyard. (Put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types.)

card.name: Captain Kirk, Boldly Going
card.text: Vigilance Spacecraft creatures you control get +3/+3. Whenever Captain Kirk enters or attacks, search your library and/or graveyard for a basic land card or a card named Starship Enterprise, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

card.name: Kirk, Enterprising Captain
card.text: Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.) Whenever Kirk attacks while creatures you control have total power 8 or greater, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn.

card.name: Klingon Strike Force
card.text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player it's attacking.) Haste (This creature can attack and {T} as soon as it comes under your control.) When this creature dies, it deals 2 damage to each opponent.

card.name: Operations Officer
card.text: Lifelink (Damage dealt by this creature also causes you to gain that much life.) When this creature enters, draw a card. Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

card.name: Picard, Steadfast Captain
card.text: Whenever Picard enters or attacks, put two +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control.

card.name: Spock, Logical Choice
card.text: Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.) {T}: Draw a card.

card.name: Tenacious Tosk
card.text: This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature. Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, put a +1/+1 counter on it.

card.name: Trelane, Squire of Gothos
card.text: Vigilance (Attacking doesn't cause this creature to tap.) Ward {2} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {2}.) Trelane can't be blocked.
